subject: POC scope and evaluation playbook for TribeCommerce multilingual search
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@tribecommerce.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Harpreet Singh <harpreet.singh@tribecommerce.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + dataset: POC for multilingual product search

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and a first pass at what we'd like to validate in the POC.

Attached: sample product catalog and a small user query set (tribe-product-sample.csv) — this contains ~2k SKUs, titles, descriptions in EN/FR/ES, and 600 real user queries with language labels.

What we want to learn in the 2-week POC:
- Retrieval relevance (top-3 accuracy) across EN/FR/ES for search queries
- Response latency at 95th percentile (target < 350ms for single-item queries)
- Cost envelope: running at expected 2k QPS/day peak (rough estimate)
- Graceful fallback behavior for low-confidence queries and mixed-language inputs

Ask from Redwood: a proposed eval plan, recommended model(s) for primary and fallback, ownership for infra and metrics, and a mutual action plan so we can sign off quickly.

Proposed timeline (open to adjustment):
- This week: scope + mutual action plan signed
- Week 1 of POC: model onboarding, dataset ingestion, baseline runs
- Week 2 of POC: blind eval, performance tuning, final scorecard

Let us know who from Redwood will own the technical setup and where we should upload more data.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product, TribeCommerce
[Attachment: tribe-product-sample.csv (csv, 2.1 MB)]

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@tribecommerce.com>
Cc: Harpreet Singh <harpreet.singh@tribecommerce.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + dataset: POC for multilingual product search

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear recap and for uploading the sample. I pulled the file and skimmed the schema — looks good for an initial blind eval.

High level proposal from Redwood for the POC (we'll surface the detailed rubric shortly):
- Primary model candidate: open-llama-7b-instruct (8-bit quant) — low cost, strong base L2 retrieval re-rank when combined with vector store and lightweight prompt templates.
- Fallback model: Llama-2-13b-chat (quantized) for hard/fuzzy matches and longer-context product descriptions.
- Language handling: run a small detection/normalize step; for FR/ES queries we'll try direct inference first and, only if confidence low, route through an m2m100-1.2B translate-normalize step + primary model.

Success criteria suggestions (we can refine):
- Relevance: top-3 accuracy >= 82% averaged across EN/FR/ES on blind set
- Latency: p95 end-to-end < 350ms for single-query path (excluding heavy translation fallback)
- Regression: no more than 5% degradation in EN baseline when enabling multilingual pipeline
- Ops: stable runs for 48 hours at pilot traffic profile (sanity check)

Ownership / roles we propose:
- Redwood (technical lead): ben_carter — infra, model config, quantization, eval harness
- Redwood (AE/PM): me (jasmine_liu) — mutual action plan, scheduling, success criteria signoff
- TribeCommerce: Liam + Harpreet — dataset, business signoff, acceptance criteria

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben will share a short eval rubric and a baseline config by EOD today.
2) We will spin up a limited trial env (hosted) and share a secure upload link for more data.
3) Sign the mutual action plan in HubSpot (I will create it and share link).

I'll loop Vivek once we have a confirmed scope for billing/credits.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | jasmine_liu@redwood.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@tribecommerce.com>
Cc: Harpreet Singh <harpreet.singh@tribecommerce.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + dataset: POC for multilingual product search

Thanks Jasmine / Liam — drafting a pragmatic eval harness below. Attaching a short rubric (poc-eval-rubric.xlsx).

Technical plan (short):
- Ingestion: 2-step pipeline — vector index (FAISS + int8) for coarse retrieval, then instruct re-ranker for final ranking. Use 512-d embeddings from open-embed-2-small.
- Models & config:
  * Primary: open-llama-7b-instruct (8-bit), batch size tuned to 16, KV cache enabled for re-rank sessions
  * Fallback: llama-2-13b-chat (int8, lower temp) used when score < 0.45 or language-detect confidence < 0.6
  * Translate-normalize: m2m100-1.2B used only for <2% of queries where direct inference fails (to control cost)
- Metrics (automated): top-1/top-3 accuracy, MRR, latencies (p50/p95/system), cost per 1k queries, language-breakdown of failures
- Evaluation methodology: blind holdout (20% of sample) + shuffled A/B prompts to avoid prompt leakage. We'll produce a CSV with per-query scoring so TribeCommerce can audit.
- Ops guardrails: limit concurrency to start, enable automatic fallback to smaller model if p95 > 500ms; instrument token-level cost reporting.

Attachments: poc-eval-rubric.xlsx (includes pass/fail thresholds and scoring sheet).

Deliverables by Monday EOD: baseline run outputs, per-language scorecard, suggested batch/quant settings for lowest cost without >3% quality loss.

Questions for TribeCommerce:
- Can you confirm expected peak query volume (QPS/day)? We used 2k QPS/day in Jasmine's note as a placeholder.
- Any restricted content or PII masking required on product descriptions?

Thanks — will prepare infra details and the upload link.

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: poc-eval-rubric.xlsx (xlsx, 140 KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up + dataset: POC for multilingual product search — commercial / MAP

Adding commercial context so we can close scope this week. Hi everyone — quick items from finance/sales side: 

1) POC length & credits: Redwood will provide a 2-week hosted POC with up to 500k tokens/day included; incremental usage billed at our standard dev rate. If Tribe wants a dedicated pool we'll propose terms after POC.
2) Acceptance gating to move to pilot: must meet two of three quality/ops gates (relevance threshold, latency p95, stable runs) as defined in the rubric.
3) Roadmap & MAP: Jasmine — please add the HubSpot mutual action plan link when created. I'll attach a short commercial summary PDF for internal reference.

Timelines (proposed concrete dates):
- 8/30: hubspot MAP + account for data upload + baseline infra started
- 8/31–9/6: POC week 1 (onboarding + baseline)
- 9/7–9/13: POC week 2 (blind eval + tuning)
- 9/14: review sync + go/no-go decision

Owner matrix (final):
- Jasmine (AE): MAP owner, schedule, acceptance criteria signoff
- Ben (SE): infra + eval harness (technical lead)
- Vivek (Sales Manager): commercial terms, credits, and renewal lead
- Tribe: Liam/Harpreet — acceptance & business signoff

Link to docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cTribePOC

I'll wait for Jasmine to post the MAP and for Tribe to confirm peak traffic. Once we have that, I'll provision the POC credits.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — appreciate the clarity and the concrete owners. A few quick confirmations from Tribe: 
- Peak volume: confirmed 2k QPS/day (spikey, mostly US + EU).
- No sensitive PII in product descriptions; we will mask vendor emails in the sample.
- We'll sign the MAP once Jasmine posts it; Harpreet will upload the full 20k-query blind set to the Drive link today.

Small ask: can Ben include a short note in the rubric about how we measure language-switch (mixed EN/FR queries)? That has been a common failure mode for our current system.

Looking forward to getting started. Shall we do a quick 30-min kickoff tomorrow to confirm the upload path and user accounts?

Best,
Liam
Head of Product, TribeCommerce
